name: Liquid Resources 1
definition: Resources of a legal entity or other financial construct that are available to meet cash obligations.

CashDue.name: Cash Due
CashDue.definition: Cash expected to be available to the CCP on each day in order to meet liquid requirements.

FacilitiesCommittedLinesOfCredit.name: Facilities Committed Lines Of Credit
FacilitiesCommittedLinesOfCredit.definition: Lines of credit with credit institutions that are contractually committed with the liquidity provider.

FacilitiesCommittedRepurchaseAgreements.name: Facilities Committed Repurchase Agreements
FacilitiesCommittedRepurchaseAgreements.definition: Repurchase agreement that are contractually committed with the liquidity provider.

FacilitiesCommittedFXSwaps.name: Facilities Committed FX Swaps
FacilitiesCommittedFXSwaps.definition: FX swaps that are contractually committed with the liquidity provider.

FacilitiesOtherCommitted.name: Facilities Other Committed
FacilitiesOtherCommitted.definition: Other liquidity facilities that are contractually committed with the liquidity provider.

FacilitiesUncommitted.name: Facilities Uncommitted
FacilitiesUncommitted.definition: Liquidity facilities that are not contractually committed.

FinancialInstrumentsTreasuryInvestments.name: Financial Instruments Treasury Investments
FinancialInstrumentsTreasuryInvestments.definition: Financial instruments from CCP treasury investments of clearing members cash collateral with any of the CCPs own cash invested included.

FinancialInstrumentsDefaultersSettlement.name: Financial Instruments Defaulters Settlement Collateral
FinancialInstrumentsDefaultersSettlement.definition: Financial instruments due to be delivered to the defaulting member that post-default can be used to meet liquidity needs in the event of their default.

FinancialInstrumentsDefaultersNonCashCol.name: Financial Instruments Defaulters Non Cash Collateral
FinancialInstrumentsDefaultersNonCashCol.definition: Non-cash collateral e.g. margin provided by the defaulting counterparty that can be used to meet liquidity needs in the event of their default.
